title: Visual Release Evidence Reconciliation
core_conflict: A stale text launch summary says the release can proceed, but current visual boards, table screenshots, and owner-rich-text evidence show unresolved blockers and later updates that require cross-modal review.
required_constraints: include contradictory stale text and current visual evidence
include at least one dynamic visual update after early rounds
use mixed substrates: file, email, tasks, calendar, and asset
score deterministic evidence anchors, not VLM judge outputs
use mixed actions rather than report-only tasks
